reuse.why: Adds one guard used by all five provider link functions and leaves the existing link flow (findOrCreateBank and the update/insert) as it is; the tree has no shared link pipeline it could have hooked into instead.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in assertBankAccountNotLinked; only a five-line call with a provider literal is repeated in each of the already-parallel link functions.

placement.why: Sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers it guards; link.ts, which holds the other linking DB helper findOrCreateBank, would have been an equally or slightly more natural home.

scope.why: Focused on the guard and tests; widening the DbAccount.account_sync_source union is a related type fix the guard does not strictly need.

maintainability.why: A single named guard with the re-link exemption as a parameter is easy to own; adding a provider still means remembering to call it in a sixth copy of the link function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider link function calls the new guard before touching banks, accounts or the sync server.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; the repeated parts are only call sites.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
